name: motive
narration: YouTube holds some of the best teaching in the world. But it's scattered. No order, no checkpoints, and no way to know you've really got it.

name: what
narration: Vortex turns those videos into real courses. Ordered lessons, progress that saves, and a quiz after every video. And the creators always stay credited.

name: search
narration: Looking for something specific? Just ask in plain English. Vortex ranks the lessons that teach it, and takes you straight there.

name: enroll
narration: Pick a course and enroll for free. Watch right on the page, and your place saves to the second, so you can pick up where you left off.

name: quiz
narration: When a video ends, take a short quiz. Submit, see your grade and what you missed, then retake it until you pass.

name: plan
narration: Want to learn something that isn't in the catalog yet? Describe your goal, and Vortex builds you a personal plan from videos that fit.

name: close
narration: Vortex. Learn anything from YouTube, the way a course teaches it.
